description: The notes page can be installed as an app (name demo-shop notes, short name Notes, standalone, start page /app/notes) and keeps working offline: its service worker controls the page, notes written offline wait in a queue and are saved once the connection is back.
acceptanceCriteria: The notes page is installable: its manifest has the short name Notes and display standalone, and a service worker controls the page.
Offline, the page shows Offline and an added note is queued (Queued: 1, Saved: 0).
Back online, the queued note is saved (Queued: 0, Saved: 1).

comments.author: designer
comments.body: Test ids: connection, note-text, add-note, queued-count, saved-count.
